CheckTitle: Security Groups with Redis port (6379) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to Redis port.
Risk: Exposing Redis (6379) without authentication can lead to unauthorized data access, server compromise via module injection, or use as a crypto-miner payload host.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
